provenance_quote: Toxin secreted by the type VI (T6SS) secretion system that acts on prokaryotic as well as eukaryotic target cells.
notes: UniProt Q9KS43=TseL/tseL, V. cholerae N16961, OLN VC_1418 (=RefSeq VC_RS06860). Dong 2013 PNAS (PMID 23362380, DOI 10.1073/pnas.1222783110) identifies T6SS lipase+muramidase effectors; abstract: lipase and muramidase T6SS effectors underscore diversity of T6SS-secreted substrates. ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: we present evidence that VasH regulates the production of a newly identified protein, VasX, which in turn requires a functional T6SS for secretion
notes: PMID 21555399 (DOI 10.1128/IAI.01266-10) abstract also: We present VasX as a novel virulence factor of the T6SS. UniProt Q9KNE5=VasX/vasX V. cholerae N16961 OLN VC_A0020 (=VC_RS13505). Exact quote match. ss_type correct.

provenance_quote: We show that the product of the gene VCA0285 is likely a new peptidoglycan hydrolase that is secreted by T6SS and that its cognate immunity protein is encoded by the gene that is immediately downstream (VCA0286).
notes: Effector real+secreted but cited primary_ref 10.1101/868539 is the biorxiv Auxiliary Cluster 3 MGE paper; the ledger verbatim quote is actually from Altindis 2015 mBio (PMID 25759499 / DOI 10.1128/mBio.00075-15). VCA0285=TseH=RefSeq VC_RS14690. uniprot blank (na). new_primary_ref corrects the off-topic DOI.

provenance_quote: The lipase and muramidase T6SS effectors identified in this study underscore the diversity of T6SS-secreted substrates and the distinctly different mechanisms that target these for secretion by the dynamic T6SS organelle.
notes: UniProt Q9KN42=vgrG3 V. cholerae N16961 T6SS spike/muramidase, OLN VC_A0123 (=VC_RS13955). Dong 2013 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.1222783110) is the muramidase effector paper; full-text VgrG3 lysozyme quote consistent with abstract+UniProt. ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: We find that Tse7 sits on the tip of the VgrG1b spike and that specific residues at the PAAR-VgrG1b interface are essential for VgrG1b-dependent delivery of Tse7 into bacterial prey.
notes: Exact ledger quote match. PMID 30455305 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.1814181115). UniProt Q9I733=tse7 P. aeruginosa PAO1 locus PA0099, DNase Tox-GHH2 T6SS effector. All identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: The Pseudomonas aeruginosa Type VI Secretion PGAP1-like Effector Induces Host Autophagy by Activating Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress
notes: Cell Reports 2016 (DOI 10.1016/j.celrep.2016.07.012) on TplE, an H2-T6SS phospholipase trans-kingdom effector of P. aeruginosa. UniProt Q9I3K2=PA1510 alpha/beta hydrolase, PAO1; PA1510=Tle4/TplE (Nature 2013 Tle superfamily). doi_resolves yes via Crossref. ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: The Atu4347-Atu4346 pair belongs to the family type VI secretion amidase effector and immunity (Tae-Tai), and the toxin likely targets the peptidoglycan.
notes: Quote attributed to full text (PMC4096383, PMID 24981331, DOI 10.1016/j.chom.2014.06.002, Ma 2014). CAVEAT: paper abstract is entirely about Tde DNase effectors and never mentions Tae/amidase/Atu4347; the amidase quote is from the full-text body which could not be independently retrieved (PMC fetch returned abstract only). Effector plausibly real; Atu4347=RefSeq ATU_RS20360, A. tumefaciens C58. uniprot blank (na). Confidence lowered to medium pending body-text confirmation.

provenance_quote: we identified a T6SS-4-dependent Mn-binding effector TseM, and its interacting partner MnoT, a Mn-specific TonB-dependent outer membrane transporter.
notes: Exact ledger quote match (ledger uses en-dash). PMID 28242693 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.1614902114), Si 2017. TseM is T6SS-4-dependent Mn-binding secreted effector in Burkholderia thailandensis, locus BTH_RS09640. uniprot blank (na). ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: These data show that Tle1 is an antibacterial effector delivered between cells by T6S, and that I2699, henceforth referred to as Tli1 (type VI secretion lipase immunity 1), protects against Tle1.
notes: Exact ledger quote in Nature 2013 full text (PMC3652678, PMID 23552891, DOI 10.1038/nature12074). Tle1=BTH_I2698 (=RefSeq BTH_RS32260) B. thailandensis, substrate of antibacterial T6SS. uniprot blank (na). ss_type correct.

provenance_quote: YPK_0952 is secreted by T6SS-3 and can exert DNase activity through contact-dependent and contact-independent entry into nearby cells of the same and other species
notes: Effector real+T6SS-3-secreted (PMID 38712967, DOI 10.1128/spectrum.04278-23, Yang 2024). But UniProt A0A0H3B0Q3 is INACTIVE/DELETED (entryType Inactive; deletedReason Not part of a reference proteome; UniParc UPI0000426DC3) so accession is dead. Locus YPK_RS04780/YPK_0952 valid, Y. pseudotuberculosis YPIII. No live replacement accession located; new_uniprot left blank.

provenance_quote: Zinc transportation is achieved by T6SS-4-mediated translocation of a novel Zn2+-binding protein substrate YezP (YPK_3549), which has the capacity to rescue the sensitivity to oxidative stress exhibited by T6SS-4 mutants when added to extracellular milieu.
notes: PMID 26134274 (DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1005020) confirms YezP is a T6SS-4-secreted Zn-binding substrate; ledger quote YezP is a substrate secreted by T6SS-4 supported. Abstract names YezP=YPK_3549; ledger locus YPK_RS17835 is RefSeq relocus of same gene. uniprot blank (na). Confidence medium on locus-id mapping only.

provenance_quote: Instead, EvpQ of [Edwardsiella piscicida] is proved to be secreted at a T6SS-dependent manner, and it can be translocated into host cells. EvpQ is thereof a novel T6SS effector.
notes: PMID 33776977 (DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2021.643498) abstract confirms EvpQ is a T6SS-secreted/translocated effector; ledger quote supported. UniProt A0AAU8P3V9=Peptidase C39 domain protein, E. piscicida EIB202, ETAE_2037 (=RefSeq ETAE_RS09465). ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: this activity is mediated by the specific interaction of Hcp1 with the antibacterial amidase Tae4
notes: Exact ledger quote match in abstract. PMID 27503894 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.1608858113), Sana 2016. Tae4 is the SPI-6 T6SS antibacterial amidase effector of S. Typhimurium 14028, locus STM14_RS02020. uniprot blank (na). ss_type T6SS correct.

provenance_quote: We further identify Tle1, a toxin effector encoded by this cluster and showed that Tle1 possesses phospholipase A1 and A2 activities required for the interbacterial competition.
notes: Exact ledger quote match. PMID 26714038 (DOI 10.1111/mmi.13292), Flaugnatti 2016. Tle1 is the Sci-1 T6SS phospholipase effector of enteroaggregative E. coli (042 = EC042_RS24190), delivered via VgrG1. uniprot blank (na). ss_type T6SS correct.
